text:
Maeve (CFO): Thanks everyone — putting the finance & runway Q&A from today’s all-hands here. Drop follow-ups and I’ll answer through the thread.
Ravi (Eng): Quick one — what’s our current runway in months?
Maeve (CFO): ~18 months at current burn, assuming no additional large enterprise commitments. That includes committed contracts we expect to close this quarter. :bar_chart:
Priya (PM): Is that post or pre any planned Dedicated capacity spend for Q3?
Maeve (CFO): Includes forecasted Dedicated ramp we’ve already budgeted. Any unplanned large Dedicated or Private deals would need re-approval.
Sofia (People Ops): Hiring question — are we pausing roles or changing approvals?
Maeve (CFO): No company-wide freeze. New roles need hiring partner + finance sign-off if >$180k TCC. All senior IC and above require exec sponsorship. Smaller IC requisitions will be reviewed weekly.
Ravi (Eng): Any immediate cost controls we should apply on our side (infra, models)?
Maeve (CFO): Yes — three practical levers: 1) Prefer smaller model variants for non-customer-facing batch jobs; 2) Turn on caching for evaluation runs; 3) Use staging infra quotas. We’ll publish a checklist in #eng-costs.
Priya (PM): Procurement — if my team needs a $12k license, what's the flow?
Maeve (CFO): Process is: open a ticket in Finance (link below), attach vendor quote, then approval flow. Thresholds:
```
- <$5,000: team lead approval (use corporate card)
- $5,000-$50,000: finance PO + 2 approvers (manager + finance)
- >$50,000: exec approval + procurement review
```
Maeve (CFO): For $12k you’ll need the $5k-$50k flow. Expect 3-5 business days unless expedited.
Ravi (Eng): Where do we put urgent requests?
Maeve (CFO): Tag @Maeve and add [URGENT] to the ticket subject. Ops-bot will surface high-priority.
ops-bot: New all-hands recording uploaded: https://redwood.company/all-hands/1746000000 (auto-message)
Jordan (CEO): To add — our goal is preserve runway while still investing in product lines that drive revenue (Dedicated, Optimize). Finance and product will co-review planned investments monthly.
Sofia (People Ops): How about contractors/agency spend? Any new limits?
Maeve (CFO): Contractor spend needs finance pre-approval if >$20k total per engagement. Try to convert long-term contractors to FTE where it makes sense and budget allows.
Priya (PM): Any changes to travel or event budgets for the year?
Maeve (CFO): Travel is back but capped per event unless exec-approved. We’ll share updated travel matrix next week.
Ravi (Eng): Will there be changes to corporate cards / per-card limits?
Maeve (CFO): Card limits remain, but we’ve tightened auto-flagging and monthly reconciliations. Finance will reach out to cardholders with new guidelines.
Priya (PM): Who owns vendor negotiations for larger deals?
Maeve (CFO): Procurement (cc: @Maeve) handles discounts and contract terms above $50k. For strategic partnerships, loop in Sales + Legal early.
Sofia (People Ops): Can you share a simple FAQ or cheat sheet for teams?
Maeve (CFO): Yup — I’ll post a 1-page FAQ + the PO template in #all-hands-followups and Confluence by EOD tomorrow.
Ravi (Eng): Thanks — very helpful.
Jordan (CEO): Appreciate the clarity. If folks have follow-ups, drop them here or DM Maeve. :thumbsup:
